summary: Banco Santander-Chile filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited summarized consolidated financial information for the period ending August 31, 2026, prepared under the Chilean FMC Compendium of Accounting Standards for Banks. The filing reports total assets of MCh$71,738,399, total equity of MCh$5,193,355 and net income of MCh$825,694, with MCh$804,696 attributable to equity holders. Chief Accounting Officer Jonathan Covarrubias H. and Chief Executive Officer Andrés Trautmann B. signed the disclosure. No special-situation event, transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor or deal mechanics are present; no risk-arb angle applies.
